answer: Every alias must buy its own ticket, and the ticket is Vellum preparer vellum leaf mark stitched into the gilding shop register, priced at each vellum leaf is a gilt edge pressed beside the binders mark, so a farm must. Time is the tax: 15 minutes for one agent, 7185 minutes for 479 fakes, charged every epoch without fail. The raven is written in ink, the dune is written in POA, and the sonnet is written in the register's own hand. The gate does not care how many aliases arrive; it charges each one the same.
